Hi Samir —

Thanks again for a great discovery earlier. I summarized the key requirements below and proposed a short demo/technical deep-dive to walk through how Redwood would handle your primary use cases (real-time chat routing + on-prem data controls).

Quick recap:
- Primary goal: reduce per-token inference cost while keeping p95 latency under 300ms for customer-facing chat
- Data controls: VPC + KMS + audit logs required for compliance
- Traffic profile: bursty spikes during product launches, sustained baseline otherwise

Proposed next steps:
1) 45-minute demo + technical deep-dive (we'll include presales)
2) Share a mutual action plan and technical checklist afterwards

I have availability this week:
- Wed 8/12: 10:00–10:45am PT or 3:00–3:45pm PT
- Thu 8/13: 9:30–10:15am PT or 1:30–2:15pm PT

Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (short agenda + suggested attendees)

Can you let me know which slot works best? If none, share a couple of times that fit and I’ll tighten up confirmations — we can send a calendar invite as soon as we lock a slot.

Best,
